headingText: Sec. 21-11. Distributing or delivering written or printed solicitation on school property.

blocks.text: Sec. 21-11. Distributing or delivering written or printed solicitation on school property.

blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) Distributing or delivering written or printed solicitation on school property or within 1,000 feet of school property, for the purpose of inviting students to any event when a significant purpose of the event is to commit illegal acts or to solicit attendees to commit illegal acts, or to be held in or around abandoned buildings, is prohibited.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) For the purposes of this Section, "school property" is defined as the buildings or grounds of any public or private elementary or secondary school.

blocks.label: (c)
blocks.text: (c) Sentence. A violation of this Section is a Class C misdemeanor.
